messages:
SRE Bot: paging webhook to PagerDuty failing to deliver pages for some users — automated incident channel created but pages didn't go out. seeing 502 from pager-proxy. rolling this into #incidents for visibility. root call: https://pager-proxy.internal/v1/events -> 502 x 12

Mike H: oncall here, I'm not seeing any pages. I did get the slack thread but my phone didn't ring. :phone: checking PD now.

Anya R: confirming — PD shows events accepted but several bindings show status `suppressed` in our delivery report. looks like a downstream filter flagged them as duplicates?

Jess L: looking at the incident-bot logs — snippet: ```2026-03-15T14:12:03Z ERROR send_event failed status=502 body="Bad Gateway" target="https://pager-proxy.internal"``` also earlier we see: `X-Suppress-Active-Paging: true` on some outbound requests. we don't set that header normally.

Mike H: who touched the incident automation config in the last deploy? I didn't. Oncall Rotation: @Anya R are you primary?

Oncall Rotation: Anya is primary, Mike is secondary. Anya please coordinate.

Anya R: I'm primary. @Jess L can you dump the webhook payload for one of the suppressed events? I want to confirm metadata.

Jess L: pasted a sample payload below (sanitized): ```{ "routing_key": "redacted", "event_action": "trigger", "payload": { "summary": "prod: notify - high error rate", "severity": "critical", "custom_details": { "suppress_flag": true } } }```

Infra Eng: that `suppress_flag` shouldn't be present. looks like a feature flag in the incident-bot logic that accidentally got flipped during yesterday's infra rollout. the flag is `suppress_stale_pages` and was intended for a different path. someone added it to the generic webhook builder.

Mike H: if pages are suppressed we need a manual escalation path asap. can we fallback to direct SMS for current oncall?

SRE Bot: manual escalation command available: `/pagerduty manual-escalate @mike @anya` — WARNING: this will bypass rate limits.

Anya R: doing manual escalate now. `/pagerduty manual-escalate @mike @anya` -> response: `200 OK, escalation triggered` but PD shows 1 delivery attempt then `suppressed` again.

Jess L: timeline: deploy at 02:22 UTC changed incident-bot v2 builder. revert candidate: `infra/incident-bot@02f4c7` -> I'll roll back the change that added `suppress_stale_pages` to the generic builder. prepping rollback now.

Infra Eng: rolling back to `02f4c6` on infra cluster. deploying to staging to verify then prod. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Oncall Rotation: while rollback is in flight, we need to notify critical customers manually. Mike, can you ping the CS triage?

Mike H: pinging CS now — @CS Triage I've escalated a potential paging outage affecting some of our customers. We're initiating manual outreach for any active incidents.

Jess L: rollback complete in prod. logs show webhook builder no longer attaching `suppress_flag`. sending a test page now.

SRE Bot: test event sent -> PD response `202 Accepted`. Delivery status: `delivered` for test user (Mike H).

Anya R: I can confirm I got the page. phone rang at 14:18 UTC.

Mike H: received test too. good. following up: need to audit last 12 hours for any incidents that may have been suppressed and re-open if needed. I'll own the customer impact list.

Jess L: creating a short script to query PD for events with `suppressed` status and incident-bot correlation id in the last 12h. will drop results in the thread and tag owners.

Infra Eng: root cause summary: accidental feature flag propagation in incident-bot webhook builder during infra rollout; header/field caused PagerDuty to mark deliveries as suppressed. mitigation: rollback + add CI test to detect unexpected fields on outbound PD payloads.

Oncall Rotation: action items:
- Mike H: run customer impact list + notify affected customers (in progress)
- Jess L: provide list of suppressed events + script (ETA 30m)
- Infra Eng: ensure rollback is documented and add CI test (ETA 48h)
- Anya R: follow up with PD contacts to confirm no missed escalations (ETA 1h)

SRE Bot: Incident severity: P2 -> became P1 on detection due to possible missed pages; downgraded to P3 after rollback and manual verification.

Mike H: posting a short status to status.redwood.com: "Paging integration incident — temporary suppression of some pages due to webhook header bug. Rollback applied; manual verification indicates delivery restored. Investigating affected events and notifying customers."

Anya R: thanks team. Jess, please attach the script output when ready and I'll re-open any suppressed incidents. Also adding a runbook note: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-fallback

Jess L: script output uploaded -> https://artifacts.internal/suppressed-events-1867778888.csv (contains PD event ids, affected services, timestamps). tagging owners now.

Mike H: customer outreach in progress. will update thread when done.

SRE Bot: closing automation loop: adding a safety check to incident-bot that rejects unknown outbound fields and returns 400 locally so deploys fail CI if they slip in. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5421

Anya R: nice. let's also add an alert when outgoing PD responses contain `suppressed` delivery statuses > 0 for 5m.

Infra Eng: noted. creating metric `incident_bot.pd.suppressed.count` and an alert rule.

Mike H: all done on customer notif. customers notified and follow-ups scheduled. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Jess L: adding postmortem stub. will fill with timeline + root cause + corrective actions. pinging ops for review.

SRE Bot: thread locked for updates; keep replying if you have outstanding items.
